# Flyfree - LLM Provider Configuration Manager

> CLI tool for managing LLM provider configurations for AI agents

## Quick Start

Install:
```bash
npm i -g @llmapis/flyfree
```

Subscribe to a provider:
```bash
ff sub 'ff://z.ai?key=YOUR_API_KEY' -a zhipu --auto
```

Configure custom provider:
```bash
ff set https://api.example.com/v1 sk-xxx claude-3-5-sonnet -a custom
```

## Core Commands

### ff sub <url> [options]
Subscribe to a provider configuration
- `-a, --alias <name>`: Set provider alias
- `--auto`: Auto-apply configuration
- `-s, --select`: Select agents to apply

### ff set <endpoint> <api-key> <model> -a <name>
Configure custom LLM provider
- Supports any Anthropic/OpenAI compatible API
- Interactive agent selection (Claude Code or Codex)
- Required: `-a` parameter for provider alias

### ff switch
Interactive configuration switching
- Browse all providers
- Select agent to configure
- Apply with confirmation

### ff list
List all subscribed providers
- Show status and agents
- Display last update time
- Highlight active configurations

### ff reset [agent]
Reset agent configuration to empty state
- Interactive agent selection
- Automatic backup before reset
- `-f, --force`: Skip confirmation

### ff restore [agent]
Restore configuration from backup
- `-l, --list`: Show all backups
- Interactive backup selection
- Timestamp-based backups

### ff unsub <provider>
Unsubscribe from a provider
- Remove provider configuration
- Clear subscription data
- `-f, --force`: Skip confirmation

## Built-in Providers

### Z.AI (智谱AI)
```bash
ff sub 'ff://z.ai?key=YOUR_API_KEY' -a zhipu --auto
```
Supports: claude-code, codex

### OpenRouter
```bash
ff sub 'ff://openrouter?key=YOUR_API_KEY' -a openrouter --auto
```
Supports: claude-code

### MiniMax
```bash
ff sub 'ff://minimax?key=YOUR_API_KEY' -a minimax --auto
```
Supports: claude-code, codex

### Custom (NEW)
```bash
ff set https://api.custom.com/v1 sk-xxx model-name -a custom-name
```
Supports: claude-code, codex (interactive selection)

## Configuration Structure

Storage location: `~/.ff/`

```
~/.ff/
├── sub.json                    # Subscription information
├── backups/                    # Configuration backups
│   └── claude-code/
│       └── {timestamp}.json
└── {provider-name}/            # Provider configs
    ├── config.json
    └── {agent-name}/
        └── config.json
```

## Subscription Response Format

```json
{
  "meta": {
    "request_id": "uuid",
    "code": 200,
    "message": ""
  },
  "data": {
    "name": "Provider Name",
    "description": "Provider description",
    "payload": {
      "providers": [
        {
          "name": "claude-code",
          "hash": "config-hash",
          "setting": {
            "anthropic": {
              "apiKey": "key",
              "baseURL": "https://api.example.com"
            },
            "modelName": "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022"
          }
        }
      ],
      "functions": []
    }
  }
}
```

## Custom Provider Configuration

The custom provider feature allows users to configure any Anthropic/OpenAI compatible API endpoint without needing a subscription URL.

### Usage Flow

1. Run: `ff set <endpoint> <api-key> <model> -a <name>`
2. Select agent interactively (Claude Code or Codex)
3. Configuration is automatically applied
4. Provider is saved for future switching

### Supported Configurations

**Claude Code:**
```json
{
  "anthropic": {
    "apiKey": "your-key",
    "baseURL": "https://api.example.com"
  },
  "modelName": "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022"
}
```

**Codex:**
```json
{
  "provider": {
    "endpoint": "https://api.example.com",
    "apiKey": "your-key"
  },
  "model": "gpt-4"
}
```

## Supported Agents

- **claude-code**: Claude Code agent (`~/.claude/settings.json`)
- **codex**: Codex CLI agent (`~/.codex/config.toml`)

## Environment Variables

- `DEBUG=1`: Enable debug logging
- `FF_CONFIG_DIR`: Custom configuration directory (default: `~/.ff`)

## Examples

### Quick Setup with Built-in Provider
```bash
# Install
npm i -g @llmapis/flyfree

# Subscribe and auto-apply
ff sub 'ff://z.ai?key=YOUR_KEY' -a zhipu --auto

# Start using
claude-code
```

### Configure Custom Provider
```bash
# Configure custom endpoint
ff set https://api.myservice.com/v1 sk-abc123 claude-3-opus-20240229 -a myservice

# Switch between providers
ff switch

# List all providers
ff list
```

### Multiple Providers Management
```bash
# Subscribe to multiple providers
ff sub 'ff://z.ai?key=KEY1' -a zhipu --auto
ff sub 'ff://openrouter?key=KEY2' -a openrouter --auto
ff set https://custom.com/v1 KEY3 model -a custom

# Switch interactively
ff switch

# Or quick switch
ff set claude-code zhipu
```

### Backup and Restore
```bash
# List backups
ff restore --list

# Restore interactively
ff restore

# Reset to empty
ff reset claude-code
```

## Common Use Cases

1. **API Provider Testing**: Quickly switch between different API providers to test compatibility and performance

2. **Cost Optimization**: Switch to cost-effective providers during development and premium providers for production

3. **Geographic Routing**: Use different API endpoints based on location or network conditions

4. **Proxy Services**: Configure through proxy or relay services for better network access

5. **Self-hosted Models**: Connect to locally hosted LLM services

## Error Handling

- Automatic backup before configuration changes
- JSON Schema validation for responses
- Clear error messages with debug mode
- Safe rollback with restore command

## Best Practices

1. Use aliases for providers: `-a myname`
2. Enable auto-apply for trusted providers: `--auto`
3. Use environment variables for API keys
4. Regular backup checks: `ff restore --list`
5. Test with debug mode first: `DEBUG=1 ff sub ...`

## Protocol

Providers can implement the Flyfree subscription protocol to enable one-command setup:

1. Host a JSON endpoint
2. Return configuration in the specified format
3. Users subscribe via: `ff sub https://your-api.com/config`

See full protocol documentation: [docs/protocol/README.md](docs/protocol/README.md)
